messages:
Ivy (partnerships): Heads-up: EU marketplace reviewer asked for a compact evidence bundle + a presign workflow that supports multiple artifacts (soc2 snapshot, pen exec summary, vuln CSV). They want checksums and a short redaction justification doc. Deadline: Fri COB.
Marco (security): I can own the SOC snapshot + redaction_map. Plan: one-page SOC snapshot (controls thumbs-up/notes) + redaction_map.txt listing removed fields and reason.
Tess (cloud): I'll provision partners/acme/2823456789/ and generate presigned upload endpoints. We should include manifest.csv with filename,size,sha256. Will support multipart for >50MB.
Rohit (SI): For the pen-test they want a "vuln-class" breakdown (CVSS-like severity, component, mitigation state). I can produce vuln-class.csv and a 2-paragraph exec summary. Also will coordinate a 60min remote witness if reviewer asks.
Camille (legal): Redaction policy reminder: cannot remove evidence of a control failure. If redaction removes such evidence, we must provide gated reviewer access and a legal justification. Send redaction_map to me before upload.
Zoe (sales): Partner PR team needs confirmation they'll be listed (embargo okay). I'll tell them we can aim for Fri as long as artifacts are uploaded by EOD Thu.
marketplace-bot: Ingestion checklist: include metadata.json with keys: partner_name, listing_id, artifact_types (comma), evidence_ts, contact_email, checksum_sha256. Also include manifest.csv and redaction_map.txt when redactions are applied. Docs: https://marketplace.docs/ingest-v3
Ivy (partnerships): Tess, can you include metadata.json generation and attach manifest.csv after checksum computed? Marco, can you aim for draft redaction_map tomorrow noon so legal has time?
Tess (cloud): Yes. Example manifest line I'll produce: soc2-snapshot.pdf,18320,ab12cd34... I'll script sha256 generation and upload. CLI snippet for multipart presign: ```aws s3api create-multipart-upload --bucket redwood-evidence --key partners/acme/2823456789/<file>```
Marco (security): Draft redaction_map ETA: tomorrow 11:00 PT. Will mark any items requiring legal review with the prefix NEEDS_LEGAL.
Rohit (SI): Proposed witness slot if needed: Wed 14:00-15:00 CET (60min). I'll share runbook and primary test vectors (auth, KV isolation, telemetry) by EOD today.
Camille (legal): I'll review redaction_map within 3 hours of receipt. If we need gated access I'll prepare a short reviewer agreement and access policy URL to include in metadata.
Zoe (sales): I'll ask partner to get CI logs and build artifacts to us by Tue 18:00 PT. If they miss, we'll document scope gaps in the manifest.
Ivy (partnerships): Action list: Marco -> SOC snapshot + redaction_map (tomorrow 11:00 PT), Tess -> S3 folder + manifest + presigns (after legal clears redaction_map), Rohit -> witness runbook & vuln-class.csv, Camille -> legal review & reviewer agreement if needed, Zoe -> partner ops coordination. I'll post a go/no-go check on Thu AM.
Tess (cloud): Note: I'll include metadata.json with a checksum field per artifact and an access_policy_url if Camille asks for gated reviewer flow.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: Do not post presigned upload secrets in public channels. Post only metadata.json and manifest.csv once upload completes.
Marco (security): Upload note: public artifacts will be soc2-snapshot.pdf and pen-exec.pdf. Full reports go to gated bucket if required.
Rohit (SI): Will flag any high-risk vuln entries in vuln-class.csv as "GATED_DETAIL_REQUIRED" so legal/security can approve gating.
Camille (legal): Received. I'll keep the reviewer agreement short and time-limited. If marketplace requests reviewer NDA we'll escalate.
Zoe (sales): Partner ops confirms logs delivery window: Tue 17:30 PT. Will ping here when uploaded.
Ivy (partnerships): Thanks team. When manifest + metadata are ready paste them here (no presign secrets). I'll send final confirmation to marketplace PM once we have metadata + checksums. :rocket:
